dedupe_keys.name: renpassg s a free and open python tool for simulating energy supply systems oemof renpassg s

description: renpassG!S - A Free and Open Python Tool for Simulating Energy Supply Systems (oemof-renpassG!S) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Center for Sustainable Energy Systems (ZNES). The application renpassG!S stands for (r)enewable (en)ergy (pa)thway (s)imulation (s)ystem capable of working with data from geographic information systems (GIS). It is based on the original idea of renpass and closely linked to the Open Energy Modelling Framework (oemof). renpassG!S is an easy-to-use application designed to model the cost-minimal dispatch of energy supply systems. Coverage: Depending on Scenario. Methodical focus: Optimization. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: global, continents, national states, TSO regions, federal states, regions, NUTS 3. Software: Python 3.4. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GNU General Public License v3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
